summary: Captures architecture-overview obligations from Project Nile that are descriptive or delegated to authoritative policy/specification documents rather than directly enforceable from Terraform plan JSON based on this overview alone.

input_schema.description: Terraform plan JSON (terraform show -json). This pack intentionally does not enforce because the source document is an overview and defers concrete provider constraints to other documents.

controls.title: Consumers use Nile self-service interfaces instead of raw cloud APIs
controls.obligation: Consumers submit provisioning requests through Nile interfaces and do not interact directly with raw cloud provider APIs.
controls.reason: User workflow and access-path requirement; not derivable from Terraform plan JSON for a single resource plan.

controls.title: Factories embed organizational standards and provider constraints
controls.obligation: Factories encode naming conventions, network topology, encryption requirements, mandatory tags, and provider-specific constraints.
controls.reason: Overview statement aggregates multiple obligations whose enforceable specifics are delegated to tagging and platform specification documents, not fully defined here.

controls.title: Validation workflows and shift-left governance use policy artifacts
controls.obligation: Policy artifacts inform validation workflows and governance review.
controls.reason: Process/workflow requirement rather than a Terraform resource attribute check.

controls.title: Provider constraints come from authoritative platform specifications
controls.obligation: Approved regions, naming conventions, SKUs, network topology, IAM integration, and encryption requirements are defined by platform specification documents.
controls.reason: This overview names categories but does not enumerate allowed values or exact plan-checkable rules.

controls.title: Candidate or deferred GCP controls must not be inferred as active from the overview
controls.obligation: Active control status for GCP must be determined through policy-catalog.md and control-matrix.md, and candidate or deferred controls must not be inferred as active from this overview.
controls.reason: Meta-governance interpretation rule; not enforceable against Terraform plan JSON.

controls.title: All human access is brokered through centralized identity provider
controls.source_section: Security Architecture / Identity and Access Management
controls.obligation: All human access to cloud resources is brokered through Walmart's centralized identity provider.
controls.reason: Human access brokerage cannot be validated from resource_changes in a Terraform plan.

controls.title: Service-to-service authentication uses short-lived identity mechanisms
controls.source_section: Security Architecture / Identity and Access Management
controls.obligation: Service-to-service authentication uses Azure Managed Identities or GCP Workload Identity instead of long-lived static credentials.
controls.reason: Potentially partially enforceable in specific resource modules, but the overview does not define concrete plan fields or resource scope for a safe generic policy.

controls.title: Direct internet exposure requires explicit security exemption
controls.obligation: Direct internet exposure requires explicit exemption approved by the Security team.
controls.reason: Exception approval is process-only, and the overview does not define exact resource patterns constituting prohibited exposure.

controls.title: Resources align to approved regions for residency compliance
controls.obligation: Approved region lists in platform specifications enforce data residency requirements.
controls.reason: Enforceable values are delegated to separate platform specification documents and are not enumerated in this overview.
